title: Proven-Payer Reduction of the Arrangement Deposit — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Truth table guidance.** Proven-payer points are taken off the deposit percentage of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement deposit according to two conditions read from the coverage account:

- **A.** the account's payment-arrangement status shows a completed arrangement;
- **B.** the latest patient-payment entry on the account was posted no more than 60 calendar days before the handling date.

Both met take off 4 points; exactly one met takes off 2 points; neither takes off none.

| A: arrangement status completed | B: latest payment entry no more than 60 days old | Points taken off the deposit percentage |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 4 |
| yes | no | 2 |
| no | yes | 2 |
| no | no | 0 |

**Boundary of B (hypothetical).** A latest payment entry posted 60 calendar days before the handling date meets B; one posted 61 days before does not. An account with an arrangement status of active or defaulted does not meet A.

The points reduce the deposit percentage itself, which is applied once to the patient balance.
